territories.title: Local Development Simplicity & Terminal Flow
territories.audience: Software developers and engineers building with open-weight models on local workstations.
territories.core_tension: Compiling manual C++ dependencies (llama.cpp/CUDA) creates setup friction, while cloud APIs incur per-token bills and latency.
territories.core_promise: Streamlined single-command local model execution and background localhost REST API orchestration.
territories.message: Run open models directly in your terminal and code with zero API token costs on localhost:11434.
territories.risks: Must clarify local GPU/VRAM hardware prerequisites to avoid low-spec CPU fallback frustration.
territories.what_makes_it_distinct: Focuses purely on developer setup speed and drop-in REST API workflow integration.

territories.title: Local Control & Privacy-Sensitive Workflow
territories.audience: Privacy-conscious developers and engineering teams handling proprietary code or sensitive domain data.
territories.core_tension: Sending proprietary code or private prompts to cloud APIs creates compliance and data sovereignty risks.
territories.core_promise: Offline local inference keeping prompts and code on-device by design.
territories.message: Build AI workflows locally where your prompts stay on your machine.
territories.risks: Cannot claim 'guaranteed zero data leakage'; must represent as first-party offline architecture design.
territories.what_makes_it_distinct: Anchors on data sovereignty and zero remote training.

territories.title: Hardware Reality & Transparent VRAM Sizing
territories.audience: Practical engineers seeking predictable model performance and clear VRAM boundary guidance.
territories.core_tension: Local AI tools often promise one-line magic but fail when models exceed GPU memory.
territories.core_promise: Transparent model-to-VRAM sizing guidance ensuring models fit memory without CPU fallback stalls.
territories.message: Know exactly which model fits your hardware before you pull.
territories.risks: May self-select out users on low-spec hardware (which protects developer trust).
territories.what_makes_it_distinct: Radical technical honesty around physical hardware constraints.

selection.title: Local Development Simplicity & Terminal Flow
selection.selection_rationale: Directly activates the verified developer wedge identified in Hacker News community research (EVID-FORUM-F119C750) and technical docs (EVID-WEB-2BAE59D7), which supports a testable developer onboarding/acquisition hypothesis for local builder adoption.
selection.why_not_other_territories: Territory-02 relies primarily on first-party privacy claims where enterprise compliance procurement baselines are unknown (TRANSACTION_DATA = MISSING). Territory-03 serves as essential supporting qualifier rather than stand-alone acquisition anchor.
